label: Bambu Lab P2S (ngokusebenzisa i-Bambu Connect)
step.bind: Ku-Bambu Connect, engeza i-P2S yakho. Yenza lokhu kanye.
step.send: Cindezela “Thumela kwisishicilelo se-3D”. Ifayela livula ku-Bambu Connect: lihlole khona bese uqala ukushicilela.
note: I-Bambu Connect uhlelo lwe-Bambu Lab lokushicilela kusuka kwezinye izinhlelo zesofthiwe, futhi ukushicilela kuqala khona.
confirm: I-OrcaSlicer ilungiselele lokhu ngamapresethi ayo e-P2S: {grams} g, {layers} izingqimba.
confirm.next: Vula ku-Bambu Connect? Akukho okushicilelwayo kuze uqale khona.
done: Kuthunyelwe ku-Bambu Connect. Lihlole khona bese uqala ukushicilela.
fail.orca: I-OrcaSlicer ayitholakali kulolu khomputha. Yifake, bese uzama futhi.
fail.connect: I-Bambu Connect ayivulekanga. Yifake, bese uzama futhi.
